opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Award can only be used to attend Society and Society-sponsored meetings.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference, covering registration and attendance at meeting dinners, plus a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow. Funding cannot be paid direct to an individual/personal account.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers (members of The Physiological Society). Funds cannot be used to pay staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for HEA Fellowship or other justifiable sundries.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers who require support to achieve their full potential, enhancing their commitment to physiology and benefiting the wider community of physiologists.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funds cannot be used to buy out teaching time, support salary costs, or attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; applications should be physiological in nature; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award. Funding cannot be used for salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow) in their second year of membership or longer. Funding cannot be used for salary costs or to attend conferences.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in teaching or research.
